title: Vague height preference requires a measurable threshold
expected: Height is now an allowlisted filter. Numeric thresholds filter only profiles that opted to show height; a vague 'tall' request asks for a minimum height instead of being treated as an unsupported relevance term.
actual: A bare 'tall' request now asks for a minimum height in centimeters. Numeric height filters return only visible profiles that meet the threshold; unsupported terms such as income no longer suppress valid profession/location matches.
reproduction: POST /api/chat/messages with 'doctors in Kolkata who are tall', then with 'doctors in Kolkata at least 175 cm'; also compare 'doctors in Kolkata with high income' against the same query without income.

title: Missing seeking preference is not clarified
expected: Use the signed-in member's seeking setting or ask whom they want to see when no setting or preference is available.
actual: The demo has no seeking setting and criteria looking_for remains null; an unspecified search returns profiles without asking, including male profiles.
reproduction: Send 'Find doctors in Kolkata aged 28 to 32' without gender/seeking preference; inspect the returned match.

title: Retry duplicates the member message
expected: Retry the failed request without adding a duplicate member message to the conversation.
actual: After a simulated network failure, selecting Try again adds the same member message a second time before the assistant response.
reproduction: Block POST /api/chat/messages once in browser, send 'Find engineers in Pune', unblock, then select Try again.

title: View profile link opens no profile detail
expected: Selecting View profile opens the selected profile's full profile page.
actual: The link navigates to /profile/<id>, but the route renders only the generic member-home page and launcher.
reproduction: Search for a profile and open its View profile link.

title: Assistant response does not stream
expected: Return status, tokens, criteria, results and completion progressively as SSE events.
actual: The only message endpoint returns a completed JSON response; OpenAPI has no assistant stream route or SSE event contract.
reproduction: Inspect GET /openapi.json and POST /api/chat/messages; only non-streaming chat endpoints are present.

title: Authentication and profile visibility rules are absent
expected: Require an authenticated member and enforce own-profile, block, deactivation, plan and owner privacy rules before returning cards.
actual: An unauthenticated POST returns HTTP 200 with profile cards. The demo has no member identity or per-field visibility metadata to enforce the required exclusions.
reproduction: POST /api/chat/messages without an Authorization header; inspect returned cards and backend visibility/auth dependencies.

title: Rate limit can be bypassed with new conversations
expected: Enforce the configurable per-member search limit across all of that member's conversations.
actual: The limiter is keyed by conversation ID and stored in process memory; 11 searches using separate new conversations were all accepted.
reproduction: Send 11 POST requests with message='Find profiles aged 21 to 45', each with conversation_id=null.

title: Input loses focus after Send button submission
expected: Keep focus in the chat input after results load.
actual: After submitting with the Send button and waiting for results, no input element remains focused.
reproduction: In the browser, send a valid search by clicking Send; after results appear, check input:focus.

title: Network failure exposes raw browser error
expected: Show the specified concise, user-friendly search failure message with retry guidance.
actual: A simulated fetch failure displays the raw text 'Failed to fetch'.
reproduction: Block POST /api/chat/messages in the browser and submit a valid search.
